newsitem.title: PANAMA: Perry to discuss U.S. bases during Panama visit.
newsitem.headline: Perry to discuss U.S. bases during Panama visit.

text.p: U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry will discuss the possibility of maintaining a U.S. military presence in Panama into the next century during a brief visit to the Central American country on Saturday, U.S. military and diplomatic sources said Thursday.
Perry will be briefed on U.S. Southern Command military operations in Panama and meet Panamanian officials, including President Ernesto Perez Balladares, the sources said.
A proposal to turn strategic Howard Air Force Base into an international drug fighting centre will also be discussed.
Perry is due to leave Sunday for Argentina to attend a regional security meeting with Latin American defence ministers.
